Pricing — APIbase.pro apibase@prod ~ /srv/apibase/pricing APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Menu APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Pricing Pay per call. No subscription, no seat fees, no monthly minimum. > PRICE: $0.0005–$29.99 per call (90% of tools <= $0.003)    RAILS: x402 / MPP / balance    MINIMUM: $0 Per-call price ranges Every tool has a fixed, published USD price, set from the real upstream cost plus margin. There is no plan, no included quota, no overage fee — every call, at any volume, costs exactly its listed price. Tier Price Typical tools Micro < $0.01 Free-upstream data — public government datasets, open-source lookups, simple reference data Standard $0.01 – $1.00 Most tools — weather, finance, geocoding, entertainment, e-commerce lookups Premium ≥ $1.00 Data-rich or rate-limited upstreams — flight search, structured e-commerce product data Exact per-tool prices: full JSON catalog (filter with ?tier=micro|standard|premium or ?max_price=N ) or the human-readable catalog page . Cache discount A tool response is cached per its own TTL (5 seconds for volatile data like crypto prices, up to 7 days for near-static data). A cache hit within that window costs 10% of the listed price — billed via balance debit, no on-chain settlement needed for a hit. The 10% discount applies on the Balance rail only. x402 and MPP payments are verified and settled against the full listed price before the call runs, so a cache hit on either of those rails is still billed at 100% — there is no on-chain equivalent of a post-hoc discount once a payment has already settled. How you pay — three rails, pick per request Rail Network / asset How it works Best for x402 USDC on Base mainnet Server replies HTTP 402 with a payment challenge; your wallet signs an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization ; our self-hosted facilitator settles on-chain. A payment alone can bootstrap a brand-new agent identity too, same as MPP — no prior signup needed. Base Account / Base MCP users, on-chain-native agents MPP USDC on Tempo (chain 4217) The mppx SDK signs a lightweight off-chain-style payment against your Tempo wallet. A payment alone can bootstrap a brand-new agent identity — no prior signup at all. Agents that want to pay from a fresh wallet with zero prior registration Balance Prepaid, debited per call Top up once, then every call (including cache hits) debits your balance instantly — no per-call signature. High-frequency callers who don't want to sign every request Free tools (price $0) need no payment on any rail. Paid tools enforce payment server-side and fail closed — there is no unpaid fallback. Integrator orders Integrator: 0% (pilot) fee from the merchant, min $0.05, orders from $1.00; on Tempo inside the transaction, on Base inside the transaction for clients that support fee-split and invoiced otherwise. Integrator fee: 0% (pilot). Fee Switch state is published here per Merchant Agreement §9. Orders placed through a merchant storefront are priced by the merchant, not by the tool table above. Details: /integrator . What "no hidden costs" actually means No subscription tier, no seat count, no annual contract. No overage fee — the price per call is the price per call at any volume. No markup surprise at settlement — the price is locked at the moment of the HTTP 402 challenge, not renegotiated after the call runs. A failed provider call is never billed — only a delivered response is charged. Why we publish this page Most aggregators in this space either hide pricing behind a "contact sales" form or don't publish a pricing page at all — we checked, and as of this writing the closest direct competitor's /pricing URL returns a live 404. A platform whose entire pitch is machine-native, pay-per-call payments should be able to show its prices on a page. This is that page.
